units.source_text: 其他诸人皆有吟咏，一概从略。

en.t: The poems composed by the others are all omitted here.

units.source_text: 这一天源氏住在外殿，他的容貌比昔年更添光彩，昳丽无比。

en.t: That day, Genji stayed in the outer hall, and his appearance shone with even greater radiance than in former years, surpassingly beautiful.

units.source_text: 这老年的僧人看了，不觉感动得流下泪来。

en.t: When the elderly monk saw him, he was moved despite himself and shed tears.
